framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 – Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Disclosure obligation triggered upon substantial acquisition; acquirer must file with exchange within 4 trading days of acquisition date.
Exemptions from mandatory public announcement and open-offer (e.g., acquisition from promoter, rights offering, allotment by rights issue) must be evaluated.

headline: HAL Offshore Limited files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations for Seamec Limited
sum: HAL Offshore Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding substantial acquisition of shares in Seamec Limited, triggering SEBI Takeover Code compliance obligations for the transaction.
detail: HAL Offshore Limited submitted to NSE a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, following a substantial acquisition event in Seamec Limited. The filing triggers mandatory disclosure obligations and potential open-offer requirements under the Takeover Code. The specific shareholding percentage, acquisition date, and consideration structure are contained in the formal disclosure document filed with the exchange.
